regime_context: China A-shares thematic detector shows a narrow, tech-led leadership with Semiconductors (rank 1) and AI Compute & Optics (rank 2) closely contested (margin 0.085). Only 6 of 22 themes eligible, indicating narrow participation. The absolute trend gate did not historically reduce drawdown in this market (mean-reverting tape), so all momentum-based leans carry significant uncertainty. Rotation breadth narrowing but no confirmed handoff.
emerging_watch: Watch for confirmed handoff from Semiconductors to AI Compute & Optics if challenger score surpasses leader for >3 days and breadth improves (>0.3). Kill if margin widens back >0.2 or Semiconductors' durability strengthens above 0.75.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors maintain the highest momentum score and trend eligibility, though the edge is thin vs AI Compute. The trend is intact (Hurst=trend, durability 0.67), suggesting continued relative strength, but the absolute trend gate's failure in this market's history weakens confidence. This lean is a tentative tilt, not a high-conviction call.
evidence: rotation leader with narrow margin over challenger
theses.dissent: Historically, A-shares trend-following whipsawed without drawdown benefit; Semiconductors could mean-revert, especially given geopolitical risks (macro narrative). The narrow breadth suggests the rally is fragile.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors score falls below AI Compute & Optics AND its durability_bar drops below 0.5 for two consecutive weeks.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
